definition: AIVA (Artificial Intelligence Virtual Artist) is an electronic composer recognized by the SACEM.
details: AIVA (Artificial Intelligence Virtual Artist) is an electronic composer recognized by the SACEM.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is AIVA.
